theme.rationale: High readability for fast-paced retail and cashier environments under bright store lighting, with dark mode toggle for evening operations.

layout_and_spacing.product_catalog_span: col-span-1 lg:col-span-7 xl:col-span-8 overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6
layout_and_spacing.cart_panel_span: col-span-1 lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-4 bg-background border-l border-border flex flex-col justify-between h-full p-4
layout_and_spacing.bento_dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6
layout_and_spacing.padding_rule: Containers with borders must use internal padding (p-4 to p-8) to prevent visual element collision.
layout_and_spacing.dense_table_style: High density, cardless table rows with subtle row dividers and crisp hover states

pos_specific_rules.currency_formatting: Always format money as Rupiah integers e.g. 'Rp 15.000', 'Rp 250.000'. Never use decimals for IDR.
pos_specific_rules.cart_steppers: Use prominent + / - stepper buttons with minimum 44px touch target size for touch/tablet efficiency.
pos_specific_rules.offline_queue: Show persistent status bar item for Supabase connection + pending queue item counter badge with trigger modal/sheet.

components_and_ui.forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox, Dialog, Sheet, and Popover. Never standard raw select tags.
components_and_ui.dropdowns: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds in dropdown-menu or popovers. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/95 border.
components_and_ui.navigation_header: Header must have sticky z-50 position with backdrop-blur-md bg-background/90 border-b. Visible menu links + outlet switcher + user profile role badge.

testing_ids.mandatory_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create creative, crisp, high-contrast POS designs that delight Indonesian cashier and business owners.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Never center align the entire app container.
Micro-animations on hover, click, and state changes for instant cashier feedback.
Always set explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements as specified.
